data.one_liner: Immutable value types with builders, enum classes and JSON serialization for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a runtime library to define immutable data models using the builder pattern. Supports enum‑like classes and full JSON (de)serialization, working together with built_collection.
use_when: You need strongly typed, immutable models with builders
You require robust JSON serialization that handles generics and nested built collections
You want enum‑style classes with additional behavior
avoid_when: You prefer a lightweight solution without code generation
Your project is small and a simple json_serializable approach is sufficient
strengths: Full support for generics, nested built collections, and custom serializers
Builder pattern enforces immutability and safe updates
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and a generator dev dependency
Steeper learning curve compared to plain json_serializable
Adds extra build step to the CI pipeline
data.setup_notes: Add built_value_generator and build_runner as dev_dependencies, then run `dart run build_runner build` (or watch).

alternatives.name: freezed
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar immutable data classes with union types and less boilerplate

alternatives.name: json_serializable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler code‑gen for JSON (de)serialization without the builder pattern
